implementation_notes: Constants live in one `const` block, shared behaviour in an exported package function, and shared types in the package that owns the concept. Go's `go vet` and duplicate-symbol errors catch most accidental re-declarations, but not duplicated literals inside functions — keep those in package-level `const`.
pitfalls: Unexported constants duplicated across packages instead of living in the owning package
String literals repeated instead of named constants
